generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: an upright shrub of slender grey stems with round leaves toothed only near the tip and sprays of white flowers with narrow petals. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 3.2 m tall at 12 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: blue-green rounded leaves; white flowers; smooth grey bark. Fruit (plant roadmap P4), as in mid-July: racemes of purple berries crowned by the calyx, a third still red. Its year (appearance.organs.bloom.season) is authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands: white flowers in April and May; berries purple in late June and July. The forest's packages show day 196 (mid-July) until the phenology of plant roadmap P5 sets the day from the date and the local climate. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): smooth grey bark; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

generator.program.note: The program the spec's authors chose to grow this form.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.
